title: Dream Team
one_paragraph_synopsis: In "Dream Team," Michael Scott starts his own paper company, assembling a small but diverse team including Pam and Vikram, while facing challenges such as securing investment and office space. Kevin struggles with phone transfers at Dunder Mifflin, causing tension among coworkers. Jim reconnects with Dwight and Charles through a soccer game, and Michael attempts to pitch to an investor named Nana, who ultimately refuses to invest. Pam experiences doubt and frustration about quitting her job and the new venture, but Michael encourages her to persevere as the Michael Scott Paper Company officially launches in competition with Dunder Mifflin.
